label: AD&D 2e — Planescape setting view (plane-scoped check kinds over the 2e base; sources are official TSR scans: CITE-ONLY, mechanics paraphrased with page witnesses)

notes: Limbo wizard casting test: roll-under the caster's Intelligence to cast ANY wizard spell on the plane (Planes of Chaos, TSR 2603, reflow p70/book p66). Pass params {score: Int}.
Failure: the spell is lost from memory. Failed in the primal soup: a wild surge occurs automatically. Failed on stable terrain: wild surge only on a natural 20, otherwise no effect.
Natural 20 always fails AND sparks a wild surge regardless of terrain (reflow p72/book p68) — reported as fumble.

Wild-magic school riders (reflow p72/book p68): on a SUCCESSFUL wild-magic cast roll level variation (Tome of Magic table — not in corpus); in the soup roll level variation TWICE and apply the more extreme (tie: 1d6 picks); wild magic cast in the soup always sparks a surge even on success.
Priest spells are not subject to this test (reflow p68/book p64).

Outcome matrix identity: lkp:2e:limbo:spellcasting-outcomes (TABLE V). Law lane: Mechanus law:planar-conditions:limbo — school sub-ids (e.g. law:planar-conditions:limbo:divination) are synthesized by the accessor per the family _id_scheme. Ref upgraded from pending-M1 by audit court-mechanus, 2026-06-06.

Limbo alteration drift (TABLE IV, Planes of Chaos TSR 2603, reflow p70/book p66): when a spell that creates matter or changes shape/form SUCCEEDS (limbo_casting passed), roll 1d100 + spell level - caster level and read the band.
Pass params {spell_level, caster_level}. The exact result is the DM's, guided by the caster's intention.
Table identity lives here (its roll carries caster arithmetic a bare roll_table cannot); Mimir points used_at plane:limbo at this kind.

Miniflux upkeep check (Planes of Chaos TSR 2603, reflow p70/book p66): when a character reaches for an item unused for some time, the DM may call a Wisdom check — roll-under. Pass params {score: Wis}.
Failure: the item has drifted — dissolved or become something else (DM adjudicates). Worn clothes and constantly-handled possessions are maintained automatically by self-image.
Even stable regions of Limbo are subject to miniflux.
Law lane: Mechanus law:plane-environment:limbo:miniflux (ref added by audit court-mechanus, 2026-06-06).

Pandemonium wind-madness save (Planes of Chaos TSR 2603, reflow p88-89/book p84-85): save vs. paralyzation, cadence DM-called — typically daily; hourly in particularly noisy regions; none in shelter (sleep may still call one). Save targets are law: Mechanus/caller supplies {target}.
Failure: advance ONE stage on the four-stage track — 1 frustration, 2 despair, 3 hysteria, 4 resignation. Plane-dwellers sit at stage four.
Stage 1 frustration: -1 Wis and Int while exposed to the noise (modifier wind-madness-frustration).
Stage 2 despair: automatically surprised in combat; once able to act, +1 to attack and damage (modifier wind-madness-despair).
Stage 3 hysteria: on the failed save the sod runs amok for minutes equal to the margin of failure (target - total), then collapses helpless — no fighting or casting; in shelter behaves as stage 2.
Stage 4 resignation: a personal quirk/phobia/mania — roleplay, no fixed dice.

No permanent cure short of wish; symptoms remit off-plane and revert in full on return. Law lane: Mechanus law:plane-environment:pandemonium:wind-madness (ref upgraded from pending-M5 by audit court-mechanus, 2026-06-06). Stage-4 quirk menu: lkp:2e:pandemonium:everymans-madness.

River Styx ingestion save, Pandemonium headwaters (Planes of Chaos TSR 2603, reflow p87/book p83): swallowing Styx water calls a save vs. spell. Save targets are law: Mechanus/caller supplies {target}.
Failure: the past life is forgotten entirely and permanently — spells, class abilities, alignment included.
SUCCESS STILL COSTS: the entire past day is forgotten.
In Pandemonium specifically, merely touching the water has no effect (deeper planes differ — their rows arrive with their books).
Law lane: Mechanus law:plane-environment:lower-planes:styx-memory (ref added by audit court-mechanus, 2026-06-06).
The Wasting — contraction check, Oinos surface, the Gray Waste (Planes of Conflict Liber Malevolentiae, TSR 2615, reflow p53/book p51): 10% chance per day spent walking the layer's surface.
Progression is diceless: drains 1 point EACH from Str, Con, Dex, and Cha per day; death only when all four reach 0; cure disease ends it.
Realm exception: Abbathor's Glitterhell admits no disease (reflow p53).

Law lane: Mechanus law:plane-environment:the-gray-waste:wasting-sickness (ref upgraded from pending-M5 by audit court-mechanus, 2026-06-06). Hope-drain is separately minted law (law:plane-environment:the-gray-waste:hope-drain — weekly save vs. spell); its progression check kind is hope_drain (the D5 follow-up, closed 2026-06-06), not this kind.

The Gray Waste hope-drain — weekly save vs. spell (Planes of Conflict Liber Malevolentiae, TSR 2615, reflow p46-48/book p44-46): for every week spent on the plane, save or begin losing the sense of self. Save targets are law: Mechanus/caller supplies {target}.

Failure: vivid dreams ransack the victim's memories and desires; imagination and willpower dissipate with them. One fully succumbed no longer wishes to leave and within 1d6 months sheds his mortal guise (the larva slide) — roll 1d6 months at the point of full surrender.

Charm interplay: a successful charm spell snaps a victim out for the spell's duration (useless after two weeks under). When it wears off, anger shields him about one week more, then he AUTOMATICALLY FAILS the next weekly save — an automatic failure is diceless law, serve it, never roll a die for it.
Lower-planar denizens are immune.

Law lane: Mechanus law:plane-environment:the-gray-waste:hope-drain (minted at the Assize; her row cites this kind by name as its progression check — the D5 follow-up, Lane-E remnant closed 2026-06-06).
Planar sense NWP (The Planewalker's Handbook, TSR 2620, reflow p101/book p99): 1 slot, Wisdom, General, check modifier -1 (baked into the target). Pass params {score: Wis}.

Predicts imminent conditions on any plane — breathability, gravity, ground stability, temperature — up to one hour before they occur. Of great use on chaotic planes; rarely helpful on the unchanging planes of law.
Law lane: Mechanus M12 planewalking-proficiencies (pending mint — witness: TSR 2620 reflow p101-103; handoff §PWH D10/Q4). Slot/category mechanics are chargen law, carried here as data.
Chaos shaping NWP (TSR 2620, reflow p101/book p99): 1 slot, Wisdom, General, check modifier 0. Pass params {score: Wis}. ANARCHS ONLY — the innate ability is determined per the Planes of Chaos rules.

A trained anarch maintains Limbo terrain with the SUBCONSCIOUS mind: uses Wisdom rather than Intelligence on the terrain-maintenance table, keeps shaping while distracted, unconscious, or asleep, and is free to act while shaping.
Capacity table: lkp:2e:limbo:terrain-maintenance (registry). Untrained shapers use Intelligence and lose the terrain when distracted.
Law lane: Mechanus M12 (pending mint — witness: TSR 2620 reflow p101).

Planar survival NWP (TSR 2620, reflow p101/book p99): 2 slots, Intelligence, General, check modifier -2 (baked). Pass params {score: Int}. Taken PER PLANE — each plane is its own proficiency; no basher learns them all.

Knows a plane's general characteristics; on that plane, checks whether something is safe — edible plants, drinkable water, gravity shifts. Only CONSTANT, ESTABLISHED dangers (the stuff of texts) can be detected; the new, rare, or remote cannot. Environment only — never denizens.
A modified version of the Fated-only 'plane knowledge' proficiency (The Factol's Manifesto, TSR 2611).
Law lane: Mechanus M12 (pending mint — witness: TSR 2620 reflow p101).

Planology NWP (TSR 2620, reflow p101-102/book p99-100): 1 slot, Intelligence, category Wizard/Priest, check modifier 0. Pass params {score: Int}; looking N days into the future adds a CUMULATIVE -1 per day — pass check_mod: -N.

Requires a celestial etheroscope (Mimir item:celestial-etheroscope, described book p134). Reads the tides of fortune on a plane; result bands: tbl:2e:nwp:planology-fortune (registry, 1d20 — DM may choose instead of rolling).
A FAILED check reads false or empty AND denies any further attempt for that time period.
Law lane: Mechanus M12 (pending mint — witness: TSR 2620 reflow p101-102).

Portal feel NWP, FIRST use (TSR 2620, reflow p102/book p100): 2 slots, Intelligence, General. A successful check at -3 (baked) grants a general feel for SAFETY — whether the portal opens onto direct and immediate harm (DM interprets). Pass params {score: Int}.
The proficiency's second use (divining the destination) is the sibling kind portal_feel_destination (-5).
Law lane: Mechanus M12 (pending mint — witness: TSR 2620 reflow p102).

Portal feel NWP, SECOND use (TSR 2620, reflow p102/book p100): a successful check at -5 (baked) divines the location of the portal's other end — at the very least the destination PLANE, though not necessarily the exact site. Pass params {score: Int}.
Never reveals the gate key. The safety read is the sibling kind portal_feel (-3); one proficiency, two uses, two printed modifiers.
Law lane: Mechanus M12 (pending mint — witness: TSR 2620 reflow p102).
Spell recovery NWP (TSR 2620, reflow p102/book p100): 2 slots, Intelligence, category Wizard/Priest, check modifier -5 (baked). Pass params {score: Int}.

Grabs hold of a spell lost ONLY to the magical conditions of a plane, layer, or realm (an illusion on Mechanus) before it fades from memory. Spells that fail for other reasons — magic resistance, successful saves — can never be recovered this way.
Law lane: Mechanus M12 (pending mint — witness: TSR 2620 reflow p102).
Planar direction sense NWP (TSR 2620, reflow p103/book p101): 1 slot, Wisdom, General, check modifier +1 (baked — positive = easier, the add_to_target direction). Pass params {score: Wis}.

Standard compass directions don't exist on the planes: this skill navigates by landmarks and benchmarks — not which way is north, but the way back to Plague-Mort, the tower of Nirrecles, or the gate to Sigil. The page offers it as the model 'planar version' of an existing proficiency (direction sense).
Law lane: Mechanus M12 (pending mint — witness: TSR 2620 reflow p103; the -1..-10 DM-discretion amendments to existing proficiencies on the same page are M12 law, not check kinds).
